chapters.label: Open the server’s Storage tab — the disks, then a file explorer
Go to any folder — type a path, or use the quick links
Folders show their sizes, so you see what fills a disk
Upload a file from your computer
Double-click a text file to edit it in the browser
Save — the file is written back to the server
Create folders, and use ⋯ for rename, copy, permissions and more
